$comment: Hand-edited inputs of pipeline:effluent-net and of the E1 screening model (context/phases/e1-effluents.md). Every number carries a source string; unverified = null, never invented.

gauges.name: Río Suquía – Centro Cívico
gauges.source: GloFAS v4 via Open-Meteo Flood API; cell hand-checked 2026-10-29 (DECISSIONS.md Phase E1)

gauges.name: Embalse San Roque – inflow
gauges.source: GloFAS v4 via Open-Meteo Flood API; cell hand-checked 2026-10-29 (DECISSIONS.md Phase E1)

tpLoadTPerYr.source: ILEC World Lake Database (domestic 45, agricultural 140, natural 5)

residenceYr.source: ILEC 0.1–0.7 yr; ≈1.1 yr from 190 hm³ / 166 hm³/yr

outfalls.name: EDAR Bajo Grande
outfalls.location: assumed at the reach's upstream end; outfall not verified (owner check)

bodMgL.source: permit limit, Decreto 847/16 Annex I as amended by Res. APRHI 31/2022 (compliance scenario)

doMgL.source: assumption: worst case, no effluent DO data

coliformsPer100mL.source: Decreto 847/16 limit not verified; no public effluent data

tpMgL.source: not applicable below the dam; no public effluent data

doMinMgL.source: assumption: Córdoba sets no receiving-water DO objective

coliformsPer100mL.source: assumption: US EPA 1976 Quality Criteria for Water, primary contact

bodMgL.source: no receiving-water BOD objective in Córdoba

kdPerDay.source: range: Chapra 1997; Bowie et al. 1985 (secondary to untreated sewage); θ: Chapra 1997; central = assumption within the range

coliformDecayPerDay.source: range: Chapra 1997; Bowie et al. 1985; θ: Chapra 1997; central = assumption within the range

kaRule.source: Covar 1976 selection of O'Connor-Dobbins / Churchill / Owens-Gibbs (Chapra 1997); θ 1.024: Chapra 1997

manningN.source: UNC report on Suquía/Cosquín/San Antonio rating curves, Aug 2026

widthCoef.source: assumption: downstream hydraulic geometry W = a·Q^0.5 (Leopold & Maddock 1953, USGS PP 252)

minSlope.source: assumption: floor for zero RiverATLAS gradients

bodBottleRatePerDay.source: Metcalf & Eddy (2003) typical BOD bottle rate at 20 °C; assumption for this effluent

elevationM.source: assumption: approximate elevation of Córdoba city, for DO saturation
